doc: A walk from `{t}` to the sources avoiding `K` is exactly `Avoids K t`.
name: DisequalityDispersion.walk_avoids._unary
typeText:
∀ {V F : Type} {arity : F → Nat} (S K : Finset.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity))
  (_x :
    (l : List.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity)) ×'
      (t : DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity) ×'
        DisequalityDispersion.Menger.Walk (DisequalityDispersion.argEdges S) (Singleton.singleton.{0, 0} t)
          (DisequalityDispersion.varVerts S) K l),
  DisequalityDispersion.Avoids K _x.2.1
